Question ID: ANP_U05_L07_GP_Q01
MLA Standard: MLA.ANP.CRI.04

Guided practice item 1.
Lesson focus: Respiratory Physiology and Gas Exchange
Stimulus: Respiratory graph/model

A student is reviewing the required visual and must explain the first visible structure-function connection. Which answer uses the lesson evidence most accurately?

generalfeedback.text: Teachable feedback: First, trace air pathway to alveoli. Then use the required stimulus (Respiratory graph/model) to connect the visible evidence to respiratory physiology and gas exchange. Correct reasoning stays inside MLA.ANP.CRI.04 and avoids the common mistake: thinking breathing and gas exchange are the same process.
